CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer!
In despair and far from home I call to you! Take me to the rock that is my safe refuge,
for you are my protector, my strong tower against my enemies.
Let me live in your sanctuary all my life. Let me find safety under your wings.
You have heard my vows, O God, and you have given me what belongs to those who respect your name.
Add many years to the king's life; let him live on and on!
May he rule forever in your presence, O God. Protect him with your constant love and faithfulness.
So I will always sing praises to your name, as I perform my vows day after day.
